about: The ground fowl at rest (SLEEP in HUNTING 2, and rest): one held pose of the body's own Lie, a roosting hen keyed from the standing pose: the body settled level on the ground as a round loaf, the legs folded under it out of sight, the wings closed, the feathers a little puffed, the head drawn in onto the shoulders and the tail level. SLEEP and rest only. A take is a fade and a drop of goods (HUNTING 10, which names no pose): no take pose is drawn; a bird taken in its sleep fades from the roost like any held pose, and the bird is never laid down into this pose for a take (an owner question, default: fade the pose it holds). One pose, a still (a one-frame list).
